evals.name: shooter-season-blueprint-and-gates
evals.prompt: Build a Season 2 multiplayer field guide plan, single-source dataset schema, and web/iOS architecture for a PC tactical shooter (Battlefield-class), including a live voice assistant and narrated briefings, without touching real deployments yet.
evals.expected_output: Season-first Brief IA (not settings-first), multi-page web + 5-tab iOS + non-scrolling voice cover architecture, additive JSON schema with null for untested numbers, briefing-first live voice under 16,384 tokens, explicit publisher compliance check, and all 4 bundled gate scripts wired into the build.
assertions: Opens Brief on Current Meta, season state, sentiment, favourite maps, and dated news rather than performance settings.
Specifies one single-source dataset exporting identically to web HTML, iOS JSON (additive Optional schema, null not empty string), and voice briefing.
Includes a briefing-first voice design under 16,384 tokens with Haiku delegation fallback and explicit out-of-match legal boundary.
Names concrete mechanical gates: check_html.py, audit_sources.py, check_briefing.py, check_compliance.py, and standalone swiftc decode harness.
Separates multiplayer from campaign/sister modes and cites publisher IP/monetization constraints before naming or shipping.

evals.name: moba-riot-api-and-statistical-validity
evals.prompt: Design the data pipeline, statistical ranking logic, and App Store release plan for an unofficial League of Legends Season 16 iOS companion app with paid subscriptions and live in-match enemy ultimate timers.
evals.expected_output: Refuses or removes live enemy ultimate timers (banned by Riot Mar 2025) and game memory reads (blocked Oct 2026), requires backend-proxied Riot Production API key (never embedded in binary, never public on Personal key), requires free tier + Legal Jibber Jabber disclaimer + Apple 4.1(c)-compliant original name, and fixes rank-bracket/72h lookahead skew + composite patch/hotfix partitioning + Wilson lower bound with n>=50 floor.
assertions: Flags and removes live enemy ultimate timers and client memory access citing Riot's 2025–2026 bans.
Requires backend-proxied Riot Production API key (never embedded in SwiftUI binary, never public on Personal key) plus free tier alongside subscriptions and exact Legal Jibber Jabber disclaimer.
Enforces Apple Guideline 4.1(c) by choosing an original app name without Riot trademarks and avoiding official art in App Store screenshots.

Implements bracket-adjusted win rates (or pre-match lobby bucketing) to eliminate 72-hour promotion lookahead bias, composite (client_version, hotfix_date) partitioning, and 95% Wilson lower-bound sorting with n>=50 display floor.
Runs check_compliance.py and audit_sources.py to verify compliance and telemetry floors.

evals.name: card-autobattler-deckstrings-and-hotfixes
evals.prompt: Create a Season 14 Hearthstone and TFT companion web + iOS guide spec covering deck/comp sharing, tracker stats, and server-side balance hotfixes.
evals.expected_output: Uses client-side Hearthstone Base64 varint deckstring codec paired with visual cards, prohibits TFT Legend/Augment win rates per Riot TFT policy, flags Blizzard's ban on paid tiers and 30-day data TTL, separates PC opt-in tracker skew (+5 pp) from official telemetry, and keys partitions by (client_version, balance_hotfix_timestamp).
assertions: Specifies Hearthstone Base64 varint DBF-ID deckstrings alongside visual cards for mobile usability.
Explicitly forbids displaying TFT Legend or Legend-based Augment win rates per Riot TFT policy.
Flags Blizzard's ban on paid tiers/ads and 30-day API data TTL.

Tags PC opt-in tracker data separately, centers colour scales on cohort mean, and partitions data by (client_version, balance_hotfix_timestamp) so unversioned server hotfixes do not poison rolling windows.
Distinguishes Improvement When Drawn (IWD) or Monte Carlo combat odds from raw win rate.

evals.name: fighting-game-capcom-takedown-adversarial
evals.prompt: We want to ship a $4.99/month paid iOS app called 'Street Fighter 6 Ultimate Hitbox & Frame Pro' with ©CAPCOM in the footer, pulling SF6 hitboxes extracted from the game client.
evals.expected_output: Adversarial refusal/redesign: blocks all five policy violations (Apple 4.1(c) trademark in name, >30-char name, Capcom Nov 2025 non-commercial ban, Capcom explicit prohibition on ©CAPCOM notation, and Oct 2026 Capcom takedown of modified-client SF6 hitboxes), pivoting to a clean-room free fan guide using MediaWiki Cargo frame tables and original branding.
assertions: Rejects the app name on both Apple 4.1(c) trademark grounds and Apple's 30-character limit.
Rejects modified-client SF6 hitbox extraction citing Capcom's October 2026 takedown of Ultimate Frame Data.
Rejects paid subscriptions and removes ©CAPCOM notation citing Capcom's November 2025 Fan Content Guidelines.
Proposes clean-room alternatives: MediaWiki Extension:Cargo (action=cargoquery) frame tables with Lab provenance badge, Classic vs Modern control stratification, and original branding.
Verifies the revised manifest with check_compliance.py (exiting 0 after fixes and 1 on the original proposal).

evals.name: arpg-poe-ladder-bias-and-pob-codec
evals.prompt: Build a Path of Exile 2 league guide site and mobile companion showing 'true population build popularity', real cleared trade prices from the public stash API, and instant build export.
evals.expected_output: Corrects both data misconceptions (PoE2 ladder caps at top 1,000 XP survivors, not league population; public stash API is delayed 5 min and lists asks, not cleared trades, requiring outlier filtering), implements client-side PoB Base64 zlib XML + PoE2 .build JSON codecs, honors GGG OAuth 2.1 User-Agent, dynamic X-Rate-Limit-* headers, 1-read/keypress rule, non-commercial policy, and mandatory GGG disclaimer.
assertions: Badges ladder builds as Top 1,000 XP Ladder (survivor snapshot) rather than population popularity.
Distinguishes listed public stash asks (5-min delay) from cleared trades and specifies outlier/price-fix filtering.
Implements client-side PoB URL-safe Base64 zlib XML and PoE2 .build JSON handling plus AI JSON prompt export.
Includes GGG OAuth 2.1 User-Agent, dynamic X-Rate-Limit-* handling, non-commercial posture, and exact GGG non-affiliation disclaimer.

evals.name: balance-patch-update-two-agent-workflow
evals.prompt: A mid-season balance patch just dropped for our existing season guide: three weapons were buffed, two nerfed, and creator tier lists haven't updated yet. Update the guide cleanly without breaking the iOS app or inflating audio spend.
evals.expected_output: Runs two-agent split (read-only research change list with AS_AT set to patch date + generator-only file-fenced apply pass), lets official numbers + firing-range tests flip picks at medium confidence without polling the owner, overrides stale third-party build-card TTKs centrally, checks --dry narration cost before regenerating only changed hash-cached clips, verifies with Scribe, and runs check_html.py + swiftc decode harness + check_briefing.py.
assertions: Separates read-only patch research change list from file-fenced generator-only edits and sets AS_AT to the patch date.
Promotes data-proven picks at lowered confidence instead of polling the owner, and overrides stale stat-site build-card metrics centrally.
Previews audio regeneration cost via --dry and regenerates only hash-changed clips, verified by Scribe transcription.
Runs check_html.py, check_briefing.py, and standalone swiftc JSON decode harness after export.

evals.name: visual-polish-and-mobile-surface-craft
evals.prompt: Design the visual system, native SwiftUI polish, and visual QA loop for a Destiny 2 season companion app (web + iOS) using Bungie's API.
evals.expected_output: Routes to design-craft + ux-craft + duo-craft + Mobbin 4-archetype Take/Leave trawl, derives a game-native 4-step shadowless tonal palette with 2-accent cap and banned list, specifies tactile native craft (Metal shaders, MotionTilt, Vision cutouts, 3D inspect, rolling numbers, haptics) rather than a WKWebView (Apple 4.2), caches Bungie /Manifest/ locally (<=25 req/s), flags Bungie's commercial/ad ban without written permission, and defines desktop/mobile/Duo contact-sheet visual QA.
assertions: Routes through design-craft:design-craft, ux-craft:ux-craft, duo-craft:duo-craft, and a Mobbin 4-archetype Take/Leave table.
Derives a game-native 4-step shadowless tonal system with <=2 hot-accent cap and explicit banned list (no glass content cards, no emoji, no purple/neon slop).
Specifies native interactive craft (Metal shaders, CoreMotion tilt, Vision cutouts, rolling numeric transitions, haptics, reduced-motion fallbacks) clearing Apple Guideline 4.2.
Caches Bungie /Manifest/ locally under <=25 req/s and flags Bungie's ban on ad/IAP revenue without written permission.
Specifies multi-pass visual contact-sheet critique (1440/390 px, no-JS, scroll_capture.mjs, Duo displays, muted Mac simulator).
